operation_rules.add: A new persistent object is present after the event while prior objects remain.
operation_rules.modify: Requires an old-to-new replacement in the same semantic slot; continued writing, a new similar diagram, and added arrows do not satisfy this rule.
operation_rules.erase: Requires persistent absence after visibility returns and occlusion is excluded.
operation_rules.connect: Requires a newly created connector and at least two persistent anchors with an explicit relation.

coverage.completeness_assertion: Every frozen A16/B17 delta appears exactly once in the 17 strict-overlap connected-component groups; validated mechanically, not adjudicated.
